newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Clashes after Friday prayers in Jerusalem.
newsitem.headline: Clashes after Friday prayers in Jerusalem.

text.p: Israeli security forces stormed on to Jerusalem's Temple Mount on Friday, firing tear gas and beating Palestinians with clubs after stone-throwing protests during Moslem prayers, witnesses said.
Paramilitary police in full riot gear had been on alert for clashes after gunbattles in the West Bank and Gaza Strip which have left 55 people dead in two days.
Witnesses said one Palestinian was shot in the head. Women retreated into the Dome of the Rock after being beaten.
Police fired rubber bullets and tear gas.
The violence was triggered by Israel's decision to open a tunnel for tourists adjacent to the Temple Mount, Islam's third holiest site.
Israeli cabinet secretary Danny Naveh said after the cabinet met on Friday that police had closed the tunnel temporarily for security reasons but he said the tunnel would not be permanently shut.
